title: Dynamic Radiative Electroweak Symmetry Breaking and Forward Higgs Mass Prediction

scope.frame: Forward RGE evolution from M_GUT = 1.88e14 GeV with modular soft boundary condition m_0 = 315.93 GeV to M_Z = 91.19 GeV
scope.object: forward dynamic trigger of radiative electroweak symmetry breaking m_{H_u}^2(M_Z) = -(238.83 GeV)^2 < 0 and forward prediction of physical Higgs boson mass m_H = 125.46 GeV (pull +1.21 sigma) without back-solving stop scale or inserting target quartic (P-396)
scope.hypotheses: Modular soft scale m_0 = M_Pl * |q|^2 * (2 Im tau_*); MSSM 1-loop RGE flow; 1-loop radiative stop loop correction

claim_one_line: DYNAMIC REWSB AND FORWARD HIGGS MASS (P-396): from the modular soft scale m_0 = 315.93 GeV at M_GUT = 1.88e14 GeV, forward RGE integration driven by the top Yukawa coupling drives m_{H_u}^2 through zero to -(238.83 GeV)^2 at M_Z, dynamically triggering radiative electroweak symmetry breaking while avoiding charge-breaking (m_{H_d}^2 = +(423.70 GeV)^2 > 0); with stop mass M_SUSY = 549.26 GeV and stop mixing X_t / M_SUSY = -1.1347, the forward-predicted physical Higgs mass is m_H = 125.46 GeV (pull +1.21 sigma against LHC target 125.25 +/- 0.17 GeV) without back-solving.
weave_or_thread: weave (forward radiative electroweak symmetry breaking and forward Higgs mass prediction from modular geometry)
